verdict.rationale: The product is a computer-use style agent that drives an entire OS, not one walled app. It leaves its own app to operate others such as Clock and Settings (docs-2, gh-1), and uses an ESP32 acting as a HID pointer via AssistiveTouch to tap, swipe and type (docs-7, docs-11, docs-8). However, that OS is iOS on an iPhone, not desktop applications, and keyboard shortcuts are never evidenced. missing for 10: control of desktop (macOS/Windows/Linux) applications, documented keyboard-shortcut support, independent hands-on corroboration of cross-app reliability.
